Tara (CS): hey team — quick intro! i'm starting coverage on Marcus's west book today. need HubSpot support seat, Dialpad softphone + SMS routing, and the latest CS playbook (is v3 live?). who do i ask for a fast turnaround? cc @Marcus
Marcus (Sales): welcome Tara! :wave: i'll DM the account list and mark priority logos. ping Ivy for seats. playbook v3 rolled yesterday — Harper, FYI updated the escalation table?
Ivy (IT): hi Tara — for CS we provision Support role by default which includes contact write + ticket linking. if you need deal edits request support_plus. fastest way is the ticket portal or the slash command. example:
```
/seat-request product=hubspot role=support_user user=tara@redwood.ai reason="CS handoff west book"
/seat-request product=dialpad seat=softphone user=tara@redwood.ai features=SMS,call-whisper location=us-west
```
If you want a direct number or SMS enabled, add request_number=true and sms=true. Note hardware requests go to Ops.
Tara (CS): great — i do need SMS for quick customer nudges and the ability to see call whispers during shadowing. also: will i get Gong listen for call recordings?
Harper (Ops): yo Tara — we shipped playbook v3 (link in #cs-playbooks) and updated the "handoff checklist" + sample intro scripts. For numbers/headset: include hardware=true and ops will ship within 48h. Dialpad softphone + number provisioning usually done in one business day if not porting.
Marcus (Sales): also add Gong Listen — i'll DM the sequence ids you should inherit. small tip: use the "CS Intro - Short" template for first outreach and tag account_tier in the ticket so CS knows SLA.
Tara (CS): perfect. one more: who owns the shared inbox for onboarding@redwood.ai? sometimes customers reply there.
Lukas (CS Manager): onboarding@redwood.ai is owned by CS Ops; we'll add you to the rotation after provisioning. I'll also assign your first two shadow accounts and set up a 30-min pairing session with Marcus.
Tara (CS): awesome — can Ops also add me to the GDPR/data handling quick note in Confluence? want to check export rules before I message customers.
Ivy (IT): included in the ticket: add confluence_access=gdpr-notes. For any admin exports you'll need a data request approved; basic integration docs and Zapier notes are readable by CS.
seat-bot: Ticket #4944 created for Tara: HubSpot (support_user), Dialpad (softphone + SMS + number request), Gong Listen, Confluence access to GDPR notes. ETA: 1 business day.
Tara (CS): thanks all — i'll wait for the provisioning and book a 20-min sync for tomorrow 09:30 PT to run the handoff checklist. Marcus said he'd bring two demo clips.
Marcus (Sales): 09:30 PT works, invite sent. i'll include the priority notes and demo timestamps.
Lukas (CS Manager): i'll join and review the escalation matrix and the first-week checklist. welcome aboard :tada:
